toggleButton: Redistribute vault key to a device
title: Redistribute vault key
description: Sends the vault key this Desktop uses today to an already-paired device — use this if that device can't decrypt the vault even though it has the right content (key mismatch, not a sync issue). You'll need its encryption key again (same field shown on the device's "Show QR to pair" screen).
keySent: Vault key sent — the device will pick it up next sync.
